text:
IncidentBot: ALERT: Spike in routing errors and retry storms across regions. Smart-routing fallback triggered multiple times. Auto-escalation to on-call.
PD-Alert: paging @Eli (oncall) — see incident 2056789123
Eli (oncall): on it. joining. can someone paste the initial error pattern?
Maya R: seeing a lot of 502s from the gateway when requests are routed to eu-west-1 then immediately failback to us-east-1. latency and retries climb.
Samir J: looks like the fallback policy picked a variant pinned to eu-west-1 due to capacity score. but there's also a sticky-variant flag enabled for region overrides — could be causing repeated reshuffle.
Kris Tan: is someone forcing a region override? that sticky flag with short TTL can cause oscillation if capacity probe is noisy.
Maya R: I see a manual action log: `force_override region eu-west-1 --sticky=true --actor=oncall` at 2056789180
Eli (oncall): that was me — I forced region to keep a major customer's traffic isolated while we investigated a model-quality regression. Did not realize sticky was on by default. :grimacing:
Samir J: ok that explains it. sticky=true means requests keep getting re-routed back, and the autoscaler triggers fallback when latency crosses threshold, causing a loop.
Kris Tan: consequences: increased tail latency and token cost; some requests hit incompatible model variants causing 5xx. we should remove sticky and unwind the override.
Eli (oncall): trying rollback now.
Eli (oncall): ```
# attempted rollback
revert_override 2056789180 --actor=Eli
# response: override removed, but routing still prefers eu-west-1 for active sessions due to sticky-session cookies
``` 
Maya R: we're seeing sessions sticky on client side, and the routing policy still has active affinity entries for that region. full unwind may need flushing affinity caches.
Samir J: don't flush caches globally yet — that could cause a flood of warmups. plan: 1) disable sticky defaults, 2) add a short canary draining rule to shift new sessions, 3) progressively drain active connections from eu-west-1.
Eli (oncall): implementing plan. disabling sticky defaults in policy config now.
Eli (oncall): ```
# update
update_fallback_policy smart-routing --sticky-default=false --actor=Eli
``` 
Kris Tan: apply canary: route 10% of new sessions to us-east for 5m then 25% then 50%.
Maya R: starting canary shift. adding drain: `set_route_weight eu-west-1=90 us-east-1=10`
Maya R: 2m in: error rate dropped from 7.8% to 3.1% for canary traffic.
Ops-Leads: any customer-facing impact? which customers affected?
Samir J: initial impact window ~2056789100–2056789360. affected customers on eu-west preferred flows saw elevated 5xx and latency. highest observed 5xx rate for some tenants ~8% during peak. no reports of data loss.
Eli (oncall): continuing rollout of weights. will gradually reduce eu-west weight to 0 over next ~12m while draining model caches there.
Maya R: draining KV caches on eu-west to avoid warmup spikes: `kv-cache flush --scope=session --region=eu-west-1 --grace=60s`
Kris Tan: monitoring token cost; cost spiked ~1.6x during loop window due to retries.
Eli (oncall): weights now eu-west=50 us-east=50. errors down to 1.2%.
Maya R: eu-west active connections dropped 65% after drain sequence. no new fallback triggers observed in last 3m.
Samir J: good. next steps: 1) remove the forced override entirely (already reverted), 2) add a guard in the console to warn when forcing region with sticky=true, 3) add an autoscale debounce to avoid immediate fallback during manual mitigation.
Eli (oncall): creating incident ticket and follow-up notes.
Eli (oncall): `INC-2056789123 — manual region override with sticky flag caused routing oscillation; mitigated by disabling sticky defaults, canary draining, and cache drain. customer impact: transient elevated 5xx and latency for subset of tenants, peak window ~7m.`
Ops-Leads: please file a postmortem with timeline and remediation tasks. assign to Maya, Samir, Kris.
Maya R: will do. also adding a dashboard alert to detect sticky-affinity surges.
Samir J: I'll put a PR up to default sticky=false for manual override CLI and add a confirmation prompt in console.
Kris Tan: ops runbook update: when forcing region, check sticky flag and prefer session draining flow.
Eli (oncall): final check — errors stabilized and cost trending back. closing page. marking as mitigated at 2056789470 :white_check_mark:
IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated by on-call at 2056789470. follow-up required: true
